# LITE fade-exit / weak-entry study — tables (generated by scripts/study_lite_fade_report.py)

Scored 1467 of 1472 cohort fills; UNSCORED (no complete 5m window or UNRES path) 5: ('BT', '2025') 5.

Δ = cell − today (+3 / −3 / 720) on the same fill, net %/fill, both priced under the same ruler. S0 = zero slip · RM = resting-maker +3 TP (fills ≥ 1 tick through) · SL = live slip (TP / cap / signal exit / BE stop −0.20, −3 stop +0.20). P = day-clustered bootstrap P(mean Δ > 0), 4,000 draws, seed 7. fired = fills on which the signal fired while today's exit was still open (all others Δ = 0, asserted). SAVED / KILLED / DEEPER = today STOP-CAP improved / today TP cut / today STOP-CAP worsened (n · Σ pts). → TP = share of the fired fills that today's exit takes to +3 (the recovery hurdle).
